run-pattern.template: Run the TypeScript pattern file at the given path using ts-node. Example: cd sys-design/creational-patterns && npx ts-node builder.ts

list-patterns.template: List all available design patterns in the sys-design directory, categorized by type (creational, behavioral, structural). Show the file paths and brief description of each pattern.

explain-pattern.template: Explain the design pattern in the given file path. Show the concept, use cases, and walk through the practice exercise if present.
